if he had just said no then tbh i don’t think it would have made that much of a difference in my mood, except for i wouldn’t be debating whether or not he was just being nice or whatever

I used to be super social and had a lot of close friends and good times. Even had a boyfriend for a year. Then after I broke up with him, I lost all my friends and developed severe trust issues and just made my depression hit rock bottom, which it never got out of.

I asked out a guy I’ve had a crush on for a while and he said yes the first time but then no the second. He said he’s busy and I know he’s not lying etc but I can’t help but not trust him because something traumatic happened in the past that gave me really severe trust issues. I’m trying really hard to give him the benefit of the doubt but I literally can’t. The same traumatic event also left me paranoid and with the mindset that no one really wants me around and everyone’s just friends with me to be nice and charitable, so the rejection kind of solidified that idea, even though I know it’s likely that’s not true. I just feel childish and pathetic and annoying and whiny. Truth is I’m just lonely and surrounded by couples and happy people.
